name: Raydium
description: Raydium is an automated market maker (AMM) built on the Solana blockchain which enables lightning-fast trades, permissionless pool creation, and new features for earning yield

methodology.UserFees: Total fees paid by users. Varies by pool: 0.25% for AMM, variable tiers for CLMM/CPMM.
methodology.Fees: Total trading fees collected from users across all pool types.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol's total revenue, derived from Treasury allocations and RAY buybacks.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Fees allocated to the Raydium Treasury (4% from CLMM/CPMM pools, 0% from AMM).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees allocated to RAY token buybacks (12% across all pool types).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees allocated to liquidity providers (88% for AMM, 84% for CLMM/CPMM).

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders across AMM, CLMM and CPMM pools.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Total swap fees paid by traders across AMM, CLMM and CPMM pools.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: 4% of CLMM/CPMM swap fees allocated to the Raydium Treasury.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: 12% of swap fees across all pool types used to buy back RAY.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: 4% of CLMM/CPMM swap fees allocated to the Raydium Treasury.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 12% of swap fees across all pool types used to buy back RAY.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: Swap fees paid to liquidity providers (88% for AMM, 84% for CLMM/CPMM).

methodology.Fees: All fees deducted from trades on the bonding curves: Raydium's protocol fee, the launch platform's fee and the token creator's fee, denominated in each pool's quote token.
methodology.Revenue: Raydium's protocol fee only. Platform and creator fees are passed on to the third parties that launched the token.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 25% of the protocol fee is used to buy back and burn RAY.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees paid out to the launch platform (e.g. StonkFun, LetsBonk) and to the token creator.

Fees.Token Launch Fees: All fees deducted from bonding-curve trades: Raydium's protocol fee (0.25% on the default config), the launch platform's fee (1% on the default config) and the token creator's fee.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees: 75% of Raydium's cut of each trade, kept by the protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 25% of Raydium's cut of each trade, used to buy back and burn RAY.

SupplySideRevenue.Launch Platform Fee: Paid to the launch platform, claimed via claim_platform_fee.
SupplySideRevenue.Token Creator Fee: Paid to the token creator, claimed via claim_creator_fee.
